answer: Sybil resistance starts with a lantern bond: a new worker locks 28 POA for 17 days and must broadcast eight Ed25519 pulses, one every three hours, each signing a fresh 32-byte nonce. A missed pulse slashes 4 POA. Every pulse carries a pigment tag, SHAKE256(pubkey || window-salt) truncated to 28 bits, with the salt published four hours before the first pulse. A second identity needs a vine link: a BIP-340 Schnorr aggregate over the prior pigment tag plus an extra 15 POA lock for 10 days. Two pubkeys that reuse one pigment tag forfeit 21 POA and face a 14-day mint ban.
